entities.name: Shakhobidin Zoirov
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Shakhobidin Zoirov is an Uzbekistani professional boxer. As an amateur he won gold medals at the 2016 Summer Olympics and the 2019 World Championships, both in the flyweight division.
